tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background — warm blueprint-paper white; Panel Black in dark.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Cards, lesson panels, inputs sitting on surface-100.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: code/spec blocks, table headers, progress tracks.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Inverse panels (footer, hero bands, cover slab). Ink-inverse text on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on any surface. 16:1 on surface-100.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata. ≥7:1 on surface-100/200.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines (decorative, not for controls).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; meets 3:1 against surfaces.

tokens.name: voltage
tokens.usage: Brand yellow (High-Voltage tape). Primary CTAs, highlights, focus fills. NEVER as text on light surfaces — only as a fill with ink-on-voltage text.

tokens.name: voltage-strong
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of voltage fills.

tokens.name: ink-on-voltage
tokens.usage: Text and icons on voltage fills (11:1).

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: Secondary brand (bare copper wire). Badges, certification seals, chart accents, illustration fills.

tokens.name: copper-text
tokens.usage: Copper when used as text or links in editorial accents (≥5.8:1).

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Conduit steel. Icons, tertiary UI, inactive tabs, chart baselines.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Success / passed / correct answer (equipment-ground green).

tokens.name: line-red
tokens.usage: Errors, failed quiz, DANGER callouts (hot conductor red).

tokens.name: neutral-blue
tokens.usage: Info, links, 'NEC reference' callouts (blue conductor).

tokens.name: arc-flash
tokens.usage: WARNING fill and icons (arc-flash label orange). Use warning-text for words on light.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning text on light surfaces (5.3:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline on every interactive element.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headlines, course titles on landing pages.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above headings; set in caps.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Learn to install, troubleshoot and inspect to code.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Always verify the circuit is de-energized before you touch it.

styles.name: spec
styles.usage: Wire gauges, ratings, code references, formulas (Ohm's law).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside buttons, badges, chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Form field padding, list item gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (mobile), default stack gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (desktop), hazard-stripe pitch.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page-level section spacing, hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inputs, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, callouts — the default.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, large media frames. Nothing rounder: the brand is hardware, not toy.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards; prefer borders, use this sparingly.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, modals, popovers.
